name: codebase-update
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Workflow for brownfield enhancements, refactors, and feature additions to existing codebases.

phases.name: Codebase Skeleton Extraction & Contract Lock
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/extract-skeleton.mjs to extract compact type skeleton (~85% token reduction). Formulate contract deltas in contracts.ts.

phases.name: Parallel Vertical Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement feature or refactor across vertical slices. Every engineer runs node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally before reporting back.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. If failed, map-failures and dispatch to responsible engineers (max 3 retries). Advance only on PASS.

phases.name: Regression Testing & Security Sign-Off
phases.instructions: Triggered ONLY after quality-gate passes. Run full regression test suite, inspect git diff for regressions, and perform security verification.

phases.name: Deployment & Release Verification
phases.instructions: Update changelog, verify Docker and CI checks, and release package.
